fusions.name: Six Feet Down
fusions.desc: Can only be used on a target at or below 25% health. A hurled spadeful deals 22 damage, up to 1.5 times that at maximum range.

fusions.name: Spadefuls
fusions.desc: Flings 3 clods of earth at once, spread apart, each dealing 7 damage. Holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Dug In
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Under the Crust
fusions.desc: Your physical attacks ignore 20% of the target's armour.
